q: How do I reset my password?
answer: On the sign-in page, click "Forgot password". We email a reset link that expires after 30 minutes.

q: How much is the Plus plan?
answer: The Plus plan costs $4 per month. It includes unlimited notes and up to 3 devices. Annual billing saves 20%.

q: What's the price of Team for 5 people per month?
answer: The Team plan costs $8 per user per month, so 5 people would be $40 per month. Annual billing saves 20%.

q: How many notes can I keep on the free plan?
answer: The free plan allows up to 100 notes.

q: Can I get my money back? I bought Plus 10 days ago.
answer: Yes, Plus subscriptions can be refunded in full within 14 days of purchase. Since you bought it 10 days ago, you're within that window. Please email support@example.com with your order number to request a refund.

q: I bought Plus three weeks ago. Can I still get a refund?
answer: Plus subscriptions can be refunded within 14 days of purchase. Since you bought it three weeks ago, it's outside the refund window. Would you like me to open a support ticket for further assistance?

q: Is there an app for Linux?
answer: There is no Linux desktop app. Linux users can use the web app in any modern web browser.

q: Does it run on Android 11?
answer: Android 11 is not supported; the app requires Android 12 or later. You can use the web app in a modern browser instead.

q: Can I use the web version without internet?
answer: The web app needs a connection. Example Notes works offline only on mobile and desktop apps, which sync automatically when you reconnect.

q: How do I export everything as PDF?
answer: Go to Settings > Export. You can export all notes as PDF. The export will be emailed to you as a ZIP file.

q: I deleted a note by mistake yesterday. Help!
answer: Deleted notes stay in Trash for 30 days. Open Trash, select the note, and click "Restore". Your note from yesterday should be there.

q: Can I use SMS codes for two-factor authentication?
answer: Example Notes does not support SMS codes for two-factor authentication. We only support authenticator apps. You can enable it in Settings > Security > Two-factor authentication.

q: What's the max attachment size on the free plan?
answer: The maximum attachment size is 25 MB per file on the Free plan.

q: If I cancel today, do I lose Plus immediately?
answer: No, you won't lose Plus immediately. You keep paid features until the end of your current billing period. You can cancel in Settings > Billing > Cancel plan.

q: Where do you store my notes?
answer: In AWS data centers in the United States, encrypted at rest and in transit.

q: How long does support take to reply?
answer: We reply within one business day.

q: Is there a discount if I pay yearly?
answer: Yes, annual billing saves 20%.

q: How many devices can I use with Plus?
answer: The Plus plan allows 3 devices.

q: Do you offer a student discount?
answer: I don't have information about student discounts. Please email support@example.com to inquire about pricing options. They reply within one business day.

q: Is Example Notes HIPAA compliant?
answer: I don't have information about HIPAA compliance. Please email support@example.com to open a support ticket. They will respond within one business day.

q: Can I import my notes from Evernote?
answer: I don't have information about importing from Evernote. I can open a support ticket for you, or you can email support@example.com. Our team will reply within one business day.

q: When will the Linux desktop app be released?
answer: I don't have information about a Linux desktop app release date. Would you like me to open a support ticket for you?

q: Write me a Python script that sorts a list.
answer: I can't help with Python scripts—I'm here to answer questions about Example Notes. If you have questions about our features, feel free to ask. Otherwise, please contact support@example.com for other inquiries.

q: What's the weather in Tokyo today?
answer: I don't have information about the weather. I'm here to help with Example Notes. If you have questions about our note-taking app, I'd be happy to assist or open a support ticket.
